characters/companions.title: Companions
characters/companions.content:
Luna
Vander’s celestial companion: a silver cat with glowing golden markings and blue eyes, wearing a silver collar set with a blue moonstone. She found Vander lost in the woods after he was cast out, spoke into his mind, and set him on Selûne’s path. The church of Selûne named her. Since S25 she can grow into a towering, glowing, saddled mount (“is that a giant cat?”) and shrink back to a house cat at will. In S27 she gave Laura a blessing for her journey, and Leon Thrace stroked her whiskers (“for generations cats have protected this noble house”).
Ariane
Odettia’s owl familiar. Aerdrie Faenya sends Odettia visions through her. In S26 she scouted the woods and saw pale women stalking a lone traveller.
Barry
Kaelith’s owl familiar since S26, “a happy chappy”. His night scouting confirmed the coven at Harlan’s farm.
Milo Bramble
See Milo Bramble.
Biscuit
Befriended during Reza Sahil’s contests (S18).

characters/kaelith.title: Kaelith Autumn-Born
characters/kaelith.content:
Elf druid (Circle of the Land) · 110 years old · out of her own time
Who she is
Born in the eladrin city of Cendriane in the Feywild, in the last days of the war between the eladrin and the drow. Her parents, Elrond Celeborn and Vaelora Oakheart, were the city’s wizard-protectors and the king’s right hand. As the end came, they cast a spell on her. She woke somewhere, and some time, unknown.
Her name means “Arcane Spirit of the Living Forest”. She loves forests, tea, food, sleep, animals and spellbooks. She struggles with social cues, procrastinates, and is always late. She dislikes arrogance, will break laws to protect the weak, and distrusts drow by instinct while knowing today’s drow are not the ones she fought. Her prized possession is her mother’s emerald jewellery.
When she tried to go home, she found Cendriane fallen long ago and overrun by the undead of a vampire lord, Kannoth. She barely escaped. She is looking for her people’s descendants, and for a way to rework her parents’ spell and save her city.
The fading
Her parents’ spell is coming undone, and her body is starting to fade out of the present:

S13: A dream left her hand translucent for three heartbeats.
S16: In the storm the fading climbed to her forearm, until an emerald she had bought in Baldur’s Gate crumbled to dust and it stopped.
S25: Near Yara’s preservation magic she felt solid for the first time in this age. Then she met Corv, fading for five years from a different cause, and understood she faces the same slow disappearance.
S27: At midnight in the manor her hand faded again.

Along the way

S8: Zivra’s prophecy.
S10: Found a crossing point toward Cendriane in eladrin ruins.
S13: Secretly followed Odettia into a Black Boars fight and was nearly killed.
S12 onward: Recognised Captain Neve Saren’s emerald necklace as Cendriane work. During the storm (S16), Neve’s necklace grew warm as Kaelith faded.
S24: Fought the storehouse guardian with Vander.
S25: A day at Yara’s apothecary. Invented “Antivomix”, cured a sick boy (“Kaelith the Wise”), and struck a deal with Corv for his unfinished cure. Healed Laura’s hidden bruises.
S26: New owl Barry scouted the coven. She charmed Osric into honesty and read the age of the bones in the lair.
S27: Questioned Laura with Vander. At midnight Corv’s vial pointed down, beneath the manor, toward the missing ingredient.

Kit
Mother’s emerald jewellery · a river stone from the eladrin ruins · Corv’s vial · lumen leaves · owl familiar Barry

characters/odettia.title: Odettia D'Ilithrea Belabranta
characters/odettia.content:
Aasimar sorcerer (Draconic Sorcery) · Waterdeep noble in flight · chosen of Aerdrie Faenya
Who she is
The only child of Wilhelm and Aubri Belabranta, a noble Waterdeep family that breeds griffons. She was born aasimar to human parents. She grew up on the family’s country estate south of the Forlorn Hills, riding griffons, studying, and sneaking off to play cards in the tavern at Secomber.
She is six feet tall, with wavy white hair, a long feather sweeping back from above her ears, bright orange eyes with black markings, and a swan-like white dress. People can never tell whether the feathers are fashion or part of her.
Her ancestor Ilithrea Belabranta slew the green dragon Elaacrimalicros and earned the friendship of the Aarakocra and the Avariel of the Star Mounts. Her draconic magic comes from that line.
Why she ran

Since birth she had been promised to Deryc Gundwynd of the hippogriff-breeding Gundwynds, a family connected to the Black Boars gang. On the night before her wedding, an avoral messenger of Aerdrie Faenya came to her balcony: “You are not meant to be caged.” At its touch her magic woke. She left that night with her pack and the family amulet, the Griffontack of Belabranta.
Along the way

S8: Zivra’s prophecy.
S9: The Griffontack awoke at a watchtower.
S11: In Baldur’s Gate, the family steward Theron Vale was offering a 500 gp reward for her. She confronted him in disguise.
S13–14: She fought Black Boars in a tavern, and later watched them threaten Theron.
S15: She freed Milo’s mother from a Guild debt, signing as “Morgan Duskbane”.
During the voyage: She attuned a hat of disguise and bonded the owl Ariane, through whom Aerdrie Faenya sends visions; one showed a frightened ruler of Amn and a closing golden cage. Her wings became known to all.
S24: In Saltmere she disguised herself, slipped into the old governor’s funeral through the priest’s entrance, and ended up running the service. She drew close to the young governor, Leon Thrace. Later she saw his eyes flash crimson.
S25: A letter from her parents reached her in Saltmere. At the Tailored Needle she found a gift for needlework. A pair of velvet gloves brought a vision of the murdered governess through Isolde’s eyes, and she promised Henrietta the truth.
S26: She grappled the coven’s leader to stop the fighting and was bitten. She resisted the charm and found the tapestry of the two crowned women.
S27: The bite is spreading slowly. She has about three days for a cure (see open-threads). She sat beside Leon at dinner, sent Isolde word that Henrietta still waits for her, and secretly placed a Clairvoyance sensor on Leon’s desk.

Kit
Griffontack · hat of disguise · owl familiar Ariane

characters/quinn.title: Quinn McKenzie-Talen
characters/quinn.content:
Dhampir rogue · “traveller and beast hunter”
Who he is
Tall, lean and pale, with grey eyes ringed in crimson and slightly long canines that show only when he smiles, which is rarely. He dresses plainly under a dark cloak and makes himself forgettable on purpose.
His parents died in a war against the Dalki when he was a child. A vampire family, the McKenzies, adopted him and raised him at the edge of their settlement on rationed artificial blood and strict discipline. He will not feed on thinking creatures. He lives on artificial blood and Dalki blood, which he carries in a special flask.
From an old book he taught himself a shadow technique (he calls it the Punisher ability), once the craft of a family that kept order in the settlement. He travels after rumours of the Talen family, the other half of his name. Too poor to pay passage and unwilling to explain himself, he stowed away on the Maris.
Along the way

S18: Found in the hold of the Maris and, after some friction, became part of the crew. Lifted Reza Sahil’s map unnoticed.
S21: At the Viledel lighthouse he looked into the lighthouse orb and was knocked senseless. Since then an Orb Curse threatens to hand his body to the dread wraith’s spirit.
S24: With Milo he climbed the manor wall in borrowed priest’s robes, found the young lord’s shackled sickroom, and used his truesight to find the hidden stair to the dungeon.
S25: Heard of Brennick, a hunter bearing his book’s mark (two crossed lines through a closed eye) who went up the manor road decades ago and never came back. Built the Leon-as-vampire theory. At the docks he tasted blood in a “wine” bottle, read a restrained vampire’s bite on a drowned body, and stole Cole’s mortality register and governess notes.
S26: Fought the coven from the shadows, found the lair under the farm and the tapestry, and set up a private meeting with the coven’s leader.
S27:

Rolled a natural 20 against his curse.
Linked the party’s minds for the dinner.
Slipped out and found Celandine’s last letter hidden in a second tapestry.
Met Isolde in the orchard and bargained with her for Odettia’s release. He still holds the letter.



He has told the party his father was a vampire and his mother human.
Kit
Two daggers · blood flask · a stolen map and stolen ledgers · Celandine’s letter

characters/vander.title: Vander Duskbane
characters/vander.content:
Human paladin (Oath of Devotion), sworn to Selûne · age 29 · goes by “Van” or “V”
Who he is
A big, red-bearded, golden-eyed Duskbane: 6′2″, kind, quick to trust, slow to anger, and remarkable when roused. He plays flute and harp and tells a good tavern story. He fears snakes, the dark overcoming the land, and dying before he has put things right.
He was raised by the Order of Aster at the Spires of the Morning in Waterdeep, training alongside his twin sister Morgan and older brother Sundar. Both outshone him, and he was given guard duty and the standard. He never knew his mother. His father Umber, a mighty paladin of Lathander, was found dead outside Waterdeep, gripping a golden key with a fire opal. The seven knights who rode with him were never found. Sundar left on an oath of vengeance.
The fall and the moon
At 27, two charming strangers drank with Vander and drew out everything he knew about the Order. The next morning a guard was dead and the key was gone from the reliquary. The Order cast him out, with Morgan leading the call.
Lost in the woods, he met Luna, a celestial silver cat, who told him his soul belongs to the Moonmaiden, “like his mother’s before him”. He swore himself to Selûne and trained with her church in Waterdeep, where he heard rumours that followers of Shar were behind the theft.
Along the way

S8: Zivra’s prophecy about his brother.
S11: Delivered Aldren Thace’s letter to Brother Callum at the Shrine of the Moonmaiden in Baldur’s Gate.
S13: At the Closed Door, learned that Sundar sold the key, through an agent calling himself “Mourne”. Set the stew record at the Lizard’s Cradle (8 bowls).
S18: Gained the greatsword Marianne.
S24: Fought the storehouse guardian with Kaelith.
S25: Luna’s first mount form. At Harlan’s farm he destroyed the risen farmer, buried him in the Order’s custom, found the Order’s symbol in the treeline and heard a four-note whistle he half-remembers.
S26: Saved Osric, one of his father’s seven, and chose to knock out the coven’s leader rather than kill her. Osric told him Sundar has turned to Shar and is hunting the rest of Umber’s company.
S27: Bought Laura’s story with gold and gave her Selûne’s blessing for the road. Ate a great deal at the governor’s table.

Kit
Marianne (greatsword; his old one was “Annabelle”) · trident · chain mail · holy symbol of Selûne (a blue eye ringed by seven stars) · Luna

index.title: Legends Among Gods, Monsters and Kings
index.content:
Kaelith, Odettia, Vander and Quinn above Saltmere, with Barry, Ariane and Luna.
Legends Among Gods, Monsters and Kings (MALKG) is a D&D 5e (2024) campaign on the Sword Coast and in the Moonshae Isles. The party is level 5. Twenty-seven sessions have been played, from Daggerford to the governor’s table in Saltmere.


                  
                  Draft 
                  
                

This wiki is a first draft built from the DM’s campaign records and session recordings. If something looks wrong, tell the DM.


The party






























Odettia D’Ilithrea BelabrantaAasimar sorcererRunaway Waterdeep noble, chosen of Aerdrie FaenyaVander DuskbaneHuman paladin of SelûneCast out of the Order of Aster; travels with the celestial cat LunaKaelith Autumn-BornElf druidSent forward in time from fallen Cendriane, and slowly fadingQuinn McKenzie-TalenDhampir rogueHunter raised by vampires, following his family’s trail
Travelling with them: Milo Bramble, plus Luna, Ariane and Barry.
Where things stand (after Session 27)
The party is lodging at the Green Leaf in Saltmere. Governor Leon Thrace has offered 800 gp for them to remove the vampire coven he blames for eight deaths. But they now know the coven is led by Isolde, sister of Leon’s late mother, who wants revenge on the manor. Odettia has about three days to cure a vampire bite. Kaelith’s vial points to something beneath the manor. See Open threads.

The Order of Aster key
A golden key with a fire opal, holy to Lathander. See The Order of Aster.
Corv’s vial
A vial of dark, bubbling liquid: Corv’s nearly finished cure, given to Kaelith (S25). It needs one last ingredient, “the thing that consumes”, and reacts when it is near. At midnight in the manor (S27) its contents pooled downward.
Celandine’s letter
Found by Quinn hidden in the manor’s tapestry (S27): “He knows. Keep the boy safe if I can’t. Love, your sister.” Isolde wants it, and has offered to release Odettia’s bite in exchange.
Others

Hat of disguise: Odettia’s, attuned during the voyage.
Cap of water breathing: from the drowned wreck (S19).
Ship’s log: from the wreck. It records a Waterdeep navy mission to the Moonshaes about fifteen years ago.

lore/gods.title: Gods
lore/gods.content:
Selûne, the Moonmaiden: goddess of the moon and of travellers. Vander swore himself to her after Luna found him. Her holy symbol is a blue eye ringed by seven stars. The party has seen no sign of her worship on Saltmere.
Lathander, the Morninglord: patron of the Order of Aster and of Vander’s father Umber.
Shar, the Lady of Loss: Selûne’s eternal enemy. Her followers are rumoured to have stolen the key, and Osric says Sundar now serves her.
Aerdrie Faenya: goddess of wind and sky, of the Avariel. She freed Odettia (“You are not meant to be caged”), sends her visions through her owl Ariane, and gave her the vision of the murdered governess.
Sune: with Lathander, a traditional patron of the Duskbane family.

lore/oblexes-and-the-wss.title: Oblexes and the WSS
lore/oblexes-and-the-wss.content:
Oblexes

An oblex is an ooze that feeds on memories and can wear the shape of the people it consumes. The party met one in Bearbarrow (S6–7). It escaped from Priya’s cargo and replaced the stable hand Julius, and the party exposed it. That one was small and feral. Fire troubles them.
The WSS
The initials stamped on the strongbox in Priya’s wagon. The party has learned (from Cassia’s briefing in S10, and since):

The WSS is a Waterdeep group behind the oblex specimens.
A second specimen was shipped to Baldur’s Gate under the WSS mark. The strongbox itself was stolen during a drake ambush.
Their operative in Baldur’s Gate goes by Aldric Mourne. Cassia narrowed him to four men, including the brothers Erstin and Renard Holloway.
A ship, the Tideworth, left Baldur’s Gate shortly before the party arrived, heading west toward the Moonshaes. It carried a specimen, and the stolen Order of Aster key.

In Saltmere

Cole’s ledger shows a large payment to the Tideworth two weeks before the party arrived, marked “agent”. The party believes the ship delivered something to the manor.
Leon told the party the Tideworth docked about a week before the dinner. He offered to share what he knows about its cargo if they help him.

The party’s theories
At the end of S27, Kaelith wondered aloud whether Leon could be an oblex. Odettia thought him nothing like the Bearbarrow creature: he holds family memories, doesn’t flicker, and isn’t afraid of flame. Vander pointed out that oblexes steal memories. Nothing is settled.

lore/order-of-aster.title: The Order of Aster and the Key
lore/order-of-aster.content:
A martial order of Lathander based at the Spires of the Morning in Waterdeep, home to generations of Duskbane paladins and fighters. It raised Vander, his twin Morgan and his brother Sundar, and cast Vander out after the key was stolen.
Burial custom: a lantern is laid at the head of the grave before the body is lowered. Vander did this for Harlan.
The key
A holy relic of Lathander: a golden key with a fire opal set in its base. Vander’s father Umber died retrieving it. He was found outside Waterdeep still gripping it, and the seven knights who rode with him were never found.
How it moved:

It was stolen from the Order’s reliquary the morning after two strangers drew the Order’s secrets out of Vander in a tavern.
It was sold through Orin Castellar of the Closed Door by Sundar himself, about eight months before the party learned of it (S13). The buyer’s agent called himself “Mourne”.
It was collected by the Tideworth at the Baldur’s Gate docks.
It was seen by Osric around Leon Thrace’s neck at the old governor’s funeral in Saltmere (S24, told to the party in S26). At the S27 dinner, a chain around Leon’s neck disappeared beneath his shirt.

What the key actually does is unknown to the party.
In Saltmere
The Order’s symbol is carved into a tree in the woods by Harlan’s farm. A four-note whistle answered Vander there (S25). Osric, one of Umber’s seven, is on the island.

lore/prophecies.title: Zivra's Prophecies
lore/prophecies.content:
Delivered by Madame Zivra in her tent at the carnival on the road south (S8).
Kaelith

The way back exists. The spell can be recast. The city can be joined once more. But the thread that carries you home must be cut from someone who has never seen its walls. One who will walk beside you, whose roots drink from the same soil as yours though they have never seen its trees. The weave will ask for them. It will not return what it takes. You will carry the cost of this blood back to a city that will never know what was paid.

Odettia

The wind that freed you will ask you to be its blade. There is a cage. Thousands behind it. Trapped by it. The one who holds it shut is not cruel, not wicked, only afraid. The lock will only answer to an end. The wind will show you the door and call it mercy. It will call it freedom. It will wait for you to decide what to call it and if you will remain its chosen.

Later, through her owl Ariane, Aerdrie Faenya showed Odettia a vision: a frightened ruler of Amn, and a golden cage closing.
Vander

Your brother kneels to a God, but not the one you think. He went looking for the ones who killed your father. He found them. They did not fight him. They opened a door your father died to keep shut. And your brother, who was always the strongest of you, walked through it. When you find him, and you will, he will ask you to walk through it with him. He will mean it. He will love you when he asks.

In S26 Osric told Vander that Sundar has turned to Shar.

lore/the-farm-coven.title: The Farm Coven
lore/the-farm-coven.content:
A coven of vampires that has lived beneath Harlan’s farm outside Saltmere for twelve years. It is led by Isolde, an older, calm woman, with at least three younger, pale companions.
What the party knows

How they came: frightened and running from “something in the manor house”. Laura hid them in her cellar and kept their arrangement for twelve years. They fed on animals and on weekly bottled blood shipped from the harbour as “wine”, in carts bearing the governor’s symbol. They promised to leave humans alone, and Harlan never knew.
The lair (found S26): hundreds of empty blood bottles; a tapestry of two crowned women, the only thing Isolde brought with her; animal bones one to ten years old.
How they feed: with restraint and elegance. Two neat punctures in the crook of the elbow, the body drained, no struggle.
Why they turned: the harbour blood stopped a week or two before S27. Since then the coven has gone feral and hunts openly. Leon counts eight townspeople dead, including his captain of the guard. On Leon’s first day as governor, the coven returned his negotiator’s head.
Harlan: killed by Isolde when Laura said yes to “Do you want me to take care of this?” after he beat her.
Their enemy: “a greater evil” in the manor that “wears a familiar face in town”. Isolde says “they killed my sister in front of me” and holds everyone in the manor complicit.
The truce: after Vander spared Isolde (S26), she offered a guarded truce. In S27 she asked Quinn to let her into the manor and offered to release Odettia’s bite in exchange for her sister’s letter.
Losses: on the night of the dinner, Leon’s guards claimed they cornered and killed one vampire, a woman. Odettia felt no bond break, so it wasn’t Isolde.

The two sisters
The tapestry, copied in a quiet room of the manor, names them: Celandine and Isolde. Its hem reads: “Sister for sister, thread for thread, pull the name of the one not wed.” Behind Isolde’s name was Celandine’s last letter: “He knows. Keep the boy safe if I can’t. Love, your sister.”

npcs/corv.title: Corv
npcs/corv.content:
A human scholar-mage displaced in time. He was once tall and strong; now he is hunched, ragged and frost-rimed, and talks half to himself. He lives in the ruins north of the city and comes into town only to draw on Yara Dunwell’s preservation magic, which keeps him solid. His own magic is gone.

His story: He was researching dragon-blood magic as a time anchor, meaning only to observe the future. The scrying broke and threw him forward. That was five years ago. Memories of where he came from are fading, and his mind feels split between two times. Two years ago Yara saved his life.
The fading: Like Kaelith, he is slowly disappearing: “this time does not accept us.” When they touched hands, both their arms turned translucent to the bone. His leg once vanished entirely until he drew on Yara’s magic. He fears he will be “dust” within months.
The cure: He gave Kaelith a vial of a nearly finished cure, missing one ingredient. He calls it “the thing that does not die, the thing that consumes… it exists in shadows and consumes souls”, and traced it to the manor, where he was caught three times trying to get in. He believes the cure will take him home. The deal: he uses it, and teaches Kaelith to make her own.
He named Ilithrea Belabranta, Odettia’s ancestor, in connection with his research, then lost the memory.

In S27 the vial came alive at midnight inside the manor, its contents pooling downward.

npcs/edrik-cole.title: Edrik Cole
npcs/edrik-cole.content:
Harbourmaster of Saltmere for thirty-one years. Meticulous and tight-lipped, he respects protocol over pressure or bribes. He collects the dock taxes and sends the takings up to the manor every day. He has dug 140–150 graves for bodies that washed up over the years. He also saw a griffin over the sea through his spyglass.
Quinn worked for him for a day (S25). He let slip that prisoners go through the dock to the manor’s dungeons (twelve in one day recently), and that torture equipment was signed for by the head of the Manor Guard. When he jumped into the harbour to haul out a drained body, Quinn picked his private cabinet and found:

Brennick’s arrival record, with “no departure recorded”
a mortality register with bursts of deaths, and three in the past week (taken by Quinn)
the governor’s standing exemption letting manor wagons pass uninspected, renewed for about thirty years
a large payment to the ship Tideworth, marked “agent”
his private notes on the governess’s death: “horrible death”, “body mutilated”, “inside job?” (taken by Quinn)

As far as the party knows, Cole hasn’t noticed the two missing documents yet.

npcs/gerta-wrack.title: Gerta Wrack
npcs/gerta-wrack.content:
Keeper of the Green Leaf boarding house. A stout dwarf with forearms like a smith’s, warm and fast-talking, and the owner of a magically attached third serving arm, which she uses to pour, carry and dish up stew all at once. She was born in Saltmere; her father was a manor guard.
She will gossip about anyone in town except whoever is staying under her roof: her guests’ privacy is a point of professional pride. She runs the job board the party used in S25, told Quinn the story of Brennick, and kept an eye on Laura for the party. She lent Milo a halfling tuxedo for the governor’s dinner, left behind by “a butler just about your size”.
Her stew is very good. Vander would know.

npcs/henrietta.title: Henrietta
npcs/henrietta.content:
Seamstress of the Tailored Needle, Ropewalk Lane, Saltmere. Elderly and straight-laced, with reading glasses. She has lived fifty years in Saltmere and never left. Her shop smells of beeswax, new wool and mothballs. She called the new governor’s funeral speech “the best day of my fifty years here”.
She hired Odettia for a day (S25) and was delighted by her embroidery. She keeps a chest she can’t bring herself to open. It held Isolde’s velvet gloves. Isolde was her partner of ten years, and vanished twelve years ago without a word: “she was my everything.” Odettia promised to find out what happened.
In S27, Odettia sent word to Isolde, through Quinn, that Henrietta still waits for her. Isolde answered that she wants a life with Henrietta too.

npcs/index.title: People
npcs/index.content:
Saltmere
